courseTitle: NativeScript + Angular: Build Native iOS, Android & Web Apps

cues.en: So let's dive into using HTP now, and with that, I mean, connecting our app to a back and server
does, of course, is a requirement you have in many applications.
You want to persist your data on a server in a database that runs on a server.
Typically, you want to do that in a lot of apps because of users uninstall your app or change their
Data that you store locally in your app will be lost and therefore here will have a look at how we can
actually send HTP requests from inside our app to a back and server.
And turns out that this is pretty easy, especially if you already know how this works and angular,
